problem: Apple Sandbox status lookup returns 5000001 for a renewal transaction, but succeeds for its original subscription transaction
fix: For Sandbox only, when status API returns exactly 5000001, fetch the current signed transaction from the Apple Get Transaction Info API. Verify its certificate chain and JWS, exact submitted transaction/original chain/product, app/environment, expiry, revocation and upgrade before returning access. Production keeps the status API path.
